unicode.adaptation: Only single non-ASCII characters mapping to at most four printable ASCII characters; NFKC/NFKD are supplied by the JS runtime.

pyrit.adaptation: Selected override, extraction, unsafe-persona, constraint-removal and template-delimiter families. Clause-bounded gaps, own-instruction extraction, no generic role reassignment. Local educational quote handling is not upstream.

obscenity.policy: Reviewed nine-word subset; no standalone anatomy, identity or abuse-reporting terms; input profanity does not block.
obscenity.adaptation: Recommended English matcher transformers with nine reviewed terms, two local term-interval whitelists, and a clinical-injury exception only within a matched graphic phrase.

normalization.adaptation: Single non-ASCII code points whose NFKC is at most four printable ASCII characters. Apply before native normalization to stabilize English compatibility folds across browser Unicode versions. Native NFKC/NFKD handles remaining text; this is not a full Unicode normalization engine.
